author: muse-b4
covers: Case provenance tagging enforcement for C25 (fixer muse-b11, branch walker/ultimate-lens-walker, build commit 40ec3645a; author of record muse-b4, named at claim time at dossier line 849 per CB-0828 — content supplied by the fixer in RECIPE-C25.md, registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's). Gate section 10 ruling #11: generated cases are tagged OBSERVED (counted) vs EXTRAPOLATED (speculative, reported separately, never summed into the coverage of record). The build enforces that separation in machinery: agree() fails closed on case_source_mismatch, the schema vocabulary check pins the tag set, the form-fuzz battery carries case-level tags, and the counting surfaces report the kinds separately with no summed total. Kind repro-steps: the steps are run-the-selftest; the expected result is 11/11 pass. The recipe artefact (per the CP-10/C25 precedent for walker rows) is the build's own wiring selftest: walker/selftest/test_provenance_wiring.py (11 tests, run with python3 walker/selftest/test_provenance_wiring.py) — executed at the fixer seat 2026-11-19 at 11/11 PASS and again on the assembled landed tree. Full evidence, including the landing-race correction of record, stands in CHECK-C25.md in the shared quality folder.
discriminator: Pre-build state, executed at premise: the provenance tag existed NOWHERE in the walker (tree-wide search, zero hits); generated cases at the rewrite and form-fuzz surfaces carried no case-level provenance; no counting surface separated the kinds, so any case count would have summed OBSERVED and EXTRAPOLATED by default — the exact failure Gate section 10 ruling #11 forbids. Failure transcript: on the pristine tree the build's selftest fails at import — concord_walker.provenance does not exist there (the enforcement it pins is the build). On the build tree: test_provenance_wiring.py 11/11 PASS (executed at the seat and on the assembled landed tree). verified_against stays null until a reviewer activates.
title: Case provenance tagging enforced — OBSERVED counted, EXTRAPOLATED reported separately, never summed; agree() fails closed on mismatch
